identity.title: What websites see
identity.intro: See the network and browser information available during this visit. Follow each reading to its source, compare related signals, and keep missing data separate from conclusions.
identity.permissionNote: No precise location, camera or microphone permission requested
identity.requestFailed: The request observation could not be retrieved. Browser readings remain available; network and TLS details are unconfirmed.
identity.egress: Public egress seen by this site
identity.snapshotNote: This snapshot describes reported settings and the connection to this site. IP location is approximate egress location, not your precise location. These readings do not establish occupation, income or identity.
identity.timelineNote: Times show when this page obtained each reading, measured from the start of this run. Collection can overlap; this is not a TCP or TLS handshake timeline.
identity.compare.userAgentNote: Compares the request header with the browser's JavaScript value. Both are self-reported and may be reduced or modified; a match does not verify the browser or device.
identity.compare.languageNote: Compares the request's preferred language with the browser's language. Browsers can shorten or reduce these self-reported values. Differences do not establish nationality or location.
identity.compare.timezoneNote: Compares UTC offsets at the same moment, including daylight saving. Different time-zone names can share an offset; matching offsets do not mean the same region.
identity.comparisonNote: A difference is a clue to review, not proof of a proxy, a person's location or a false identity. Missing readings remain unconfirmed.
identity.exportNote: By default, the report removes IP addresses, JA3/JA4, User-Agent and GPU details. Region and other device readings remain. The JSON file downloads locally; this action does not upload it.
identity.includeSensitive: Include IP, fingerprints, User-Agent and GPU details
identity.exportHidden: Sensitive fields remain excluded while privacy hiding is enabled.
identity.moreNote: Open a dedicated tool for DNS, WebRTC, fingerprint or environment checks. Those active checks do not run automatically on this page.
identity.limitsText: Cloudflare Workers does not provide TCP fingerprints, TCP round-trip measurements or HTTP/2 fingerprints here. JA3/JA4 availability depends on Cloudflare account support. Unavailable fields are left empty. No precise location is requested, and browser reports cannot verify who you are.
